properties.name: ePost Global
properties.description:
ePost Global is a U.S.-based international parcel consolidator and multi-carrier shipping network built for ecommerce platforms, 3PLs, and DTC brands shipping cross-border at scale. With more than 900 years of combined industry experience across the team, ePost Global brings together proprietary technology, deep compliance expertise, and a carrier-agnostic routing network to give shippers the resilience, predictability, and international growth capability that no single-carrier model can deliver.

Shipping more than 23 million items annually, ePost Global operates as a resilience layer between brands and the volatility of global logistics, routing dynamically across 100+ final-mile carriers and maintaining in-market presence across key international markets, including Canada, the UK, Germany, Mexico, Hong Kong, and Australia. The result is a shipping infrastructure that absorbs disruption, protects customer experience, and keeps international growth on track, even when the market isn't cooperating.
